title: P1: CoAP proxy incomplete response option relaying
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/proxy.py (lines 102-104)

The proxy only relays content_format but not other standard CoAP response options. Missing:
- ETag (caching broken)
- Max-Age (default 60s applied instead of server's value)
- Location-Path, Location-Query (POST creating resources fails)
- Block1, Block2 (blockwise transfers fail)
- Observe (observation sequence numbers lost)

Impact: Caching semantics incorrect, resource creation broken, blockwise transfers fail.

Fix: Relay all safe-to-proxy response options per RFC 7252 section 5.7.2.
